name: parallax-layers
summary: Drag across a layered scene: near layers slide further while it tilts in 3D.
props: How far a depth-1 layer moves, in points.
Scene tilt in degrees; 0 for flat parallax.
Drift on its own while untouched.
Clip layers to the scene's rounded box.
Describes the scene for screen readers.
0 stays put, 1 moves the full travel, negative moves the other way.
Extra scale; far layers (depth ≤ 0.35) grow just enough to hide their edges.
Style for the layer (it fills the scene).
behavior: The finger position steers the scene and release springs it back to centre. A parent ScrollView can still take over a scroll that starts on it.
Each layer moves by its depth times travel while the whole scene tilts in perspective. Left alone, it drifts slowly on a loop.
With accessibilityLabel the scene is one image element with that label; without it, it is not exposed.
Transforms run on the native driver with PanResponder, so it works on iOS, Android and web with no native modules.
